basics.description: An out of the box Sentinel solution deployment provided by Softwerx.

basics.name: workspaceName
basics.label: Workspace Name
basics.toolTip: The Workspace name should include 4-63 letters, digits or '-'. The '-' shouldn't be the first or the last symbol.

constraints.validationMessage: Only alphanumeric characters are allowed, and the value must be 1-30 characters long.
Retention must be between 30 and 730 days.

basics.name: pricingTier
basics.label: Select pricing tier for Sentinel and Log Analytics
basics.toolTip: Visit [Azure Monitor Pricing page](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/monitor/) for more information.

options.text: Please select which settings you would like to enable in your Microsoft Sentinel environment

elements.name: enableUeba
elements.label: Enable User Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA)? Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.
elements.toolTip: Enables UEBA entity provider sync. Only select 'Active Directory' if Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) is already deployed and onboarded — selecting it without MDI will fail with a precondition error. 'Microsoft Entra ID' has no such prerequisite.

elements.name: identityProviders
elements.label: Select which Identity Providers will be synchronized with UEBA
elements.toolTip: Select the identity providers that you would like to enable for UEBA

elements.name: enableDiagnostics
elements.label: Enable Sentinel health diagnostics?
elements.toolTip: This will enable diagnostics settings for Analytics rules, Data Connectors and Automation rules. [Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/health-audit)

options.text: Please select which Solutions you want to install into your Microsoft Sentinel environment. Solutions may contain different content types, like data connectors, analytics rules, parsers, workbooks, playbooks, hunting queries, etc.

elements.name: enableSolutions1P
elements.label: Select Microsoft Content Hub solutions to install
elements.toolTip: Select the Microsoft solutions that you would like to install

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Entra ID
allowedValues.description: Gain insights into Microsoft Entra ID by connecting Audit and Sign-in logs to Microsoft Sentinel to gather insights around Microsoft Entra ID scenarios.

allowedValues.label: Azure Activity
allowedValues.description: The Azure Activity solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest Azure Activity Administrative, Security, Service Health, Alert, Recommendation, Policy, Autoscale and Resource Health logs using Diagnostic Settings into Microsoft Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Defender for Cloud solution for Microsoft Sentinel allows you to ingest Security alerts reported in Microsoft Defender for Cloud on assessing your hybrid cloud workload's security posture.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender XDR
allowedValues.description: Incident and alert synchronization with Microsoft Defender XDR. Relevant license and Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
allowedValues.description: By connecting with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps you will gain visibility into your cloud apps, get sophisticated analytics to identify and combat cyberthreats, and control how your data travels.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft 365
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft 365 solution for Sentinel enables you to ingest operational logs from Microsoft 365 to gain insights into user and admin activity across Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams.

allowedValues.label: Azure Key Vault
allowedValues.description: Azure Key Vault Solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to stream Azure Key Vault diagnostics logs into Microsoft Sentinel, allowing you to continuously monitor activity in all your instances.

allowedValues.label: Azure Network Security Groups
allowedValues.description: The Azure Network Security Group solution enables you to stream and ingest diagnostic logs from your Azure NSG instances for Security Monitoring into Microsoft Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Azure Storage
allowedValues.description: The Azure Storage account Solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to stream Azure Storage accounts diagnostics logs into your Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

allowedValues.label: Azure SQL Database
allowedValues.description: The Azure SQL Database Solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to stream Azure SQL database audit and diagnostic logs into Microsoft Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Threat Intelligence (NEW)
allowedValues.description: The updated Threat Intelligence solution ingests threat indicators into the ThreatIntelIndicatorsV2 table, with analytic rules, workbooks, and hunting queries for matching TI data with event data.

allowedValues.label: Azure Kubernetes Service
allowedValues.description: The Azure Kubernetes Service solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to collect and analyse Kubernetes audit logs and diagnostics for threat detection and monitoring of AKS clusters.

allowedValues.label: Azure Firewall
allowedValues.description: The Azure Firewall solution provides visibility into Azure Firewall activity including application and network rule logs, threat intelligence alerts, and DNS proxy logs.

allowedValues.label: Azure Web Application Firewall
allowedValues.description: The Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) solution enables monitoring of WAF events from Application Gateway, Front Door, and CDN, including detection rules, blocked requests, and bot protection events.

allowedValues.label: Dynamics 365
allowedValues.description: The Dynamics 365 solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to monitor Dynamics 365 activity logs for suspicious behaviour, configuration changes, and audit events across your Dynamics 365 environment.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Power BI
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Power BI solution for Microsoft Sentinel provides visibility into Power BI audit activity, including dashboard views, dataset access, report sharing, and workspace configuration changes.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Project
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Project solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables monitoring of Project activity logs, providing visibility into project creation, access, and configuration changes.

allowedValues.label: Windows Security Events
allowedValues.description: The Windows Security Events solution provides analytics rules, workbooks, and hunting queries for Windows Security Event data collected via Azure Monitor Agent (AMA). Requires agent deployment and Data Collection Rules on target machines — not fully automated by this deployment.

allowedValues.label: Common Event Format (CEF)
allowedValues.description: The CEF solution provides parsers, analytics rules, and workbooks for ingesting CEF-formatted syslog data from security appliances. Requires a CEF forwarder or AMA syslog configuration on a Linux collector — not fully automated by this deployment.

elements.name: enableSolutionsEssentials
elements.label: Select Essentials Content Hub solutions to install
elements.toolTip: Select essentials solutions that you would like to install

allowedValues.label: Attacker Tools Threat Protection Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Attacker Tools Threat Protection Essentials solution contains security content that is relevant for detection of tools commonly used by attackers in various campaigns.

allowedValues.label: Cloud Identity Threat Protection Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Cloud Identity Threat Protection Essentials solution looks for most common cloud focused identity attacks such as Suspicious Sign-ins, privilege grants, MFA disable etc.

allowedValues.label: Cloud Service Threat Protection Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Cloud Service Threat Protection Essentials contains security content that is relevant for detection of attacks against various cloud services like key vault, storage, compute etc.

allowedValues.label: Endpoint Threat Protection Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Endpoint Threat Protection Essentials solution provides content to monitor, detect and investigate threats related to windows machines.

allowedValues.label: Network Session Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Network Session Essentials solution leverages the Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM) to correlate insights across 15+ networking data sources.

allowedValues.label: Network Threat Protection Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Network Threat Protection Essentials solution contains queries that identifies suspicious network behavior based on various data sources ingested in Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: SOC Handbook
allowedValues.description: The SOC Handbook solution for Microsoft Sentinel provides a collection of resources that enable and empower SOC Analysts to get better visibility and understanding of point-in-time security posture.

allowedValues.label: UEBA Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Sentinel UEBA content package will provide you with various queries based on UEBA tables, that allows you to hunt for tailored threat scenarios.

options.text: Select which Data Connectors to configure. Do NOT select items marked CAUTION if your tenant uses the Microsoft Defender XDR portal.

elements.name: enableDataConnectors
elements.label: Select data connectors to onboard
elements.toolTip: Select the data connectors that you would like to enable

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Entra ID
allowedValues.description: Configures tenant-level diagnostic settings to forward sign-in, audit, non-interactive, service principal, managed identity, provisioning, and identity risk logs to Sentinel. Requires Global Administrator or Security Administrator.

allowedValues.label: Azure Activity
allowedValues.description: Ingest Azure subscription Activity logs (administrative, security, service health, policy, etc.) into Sentinel via subscription-level diagnostic settings. Subscription Owner or Contributor permission required.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender XDR
allowedValues.description: Sync Microsoft Defender XDR incidents and alerts into Sentinel. Enables bi-directional incident sync. Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams)
allowedValues.description: Ingest Office 365 activity logs from Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams. Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
allowedValues.description: Ingest security alerts from Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Security Reader permission required.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Entra ID Identity Protection (CAUTION)
allowedValues.description: WARNING: Do not select this if your tenant uses Microsoft Defender XDR — Identity Protection is managed by the XDR portal and this will fail with a conflict error. Configure via the Defender portal instead.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (CAUTION)
allowedValues.description: WARNING: Do not select this if your tenant manages Defender for Cloud Apps through the Microsoft Defender XDR portal — it will fail with a conflict error. Configure via the Defender portal instead.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Power BI
allowedValues.description: Ingest Power BI audit logs into Sentinel. Requires the Microsoft Power BI solution to also be selected. Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Project
allowedValues.description: Ingest Microsoft Project activity logs into Sentinel. Requires the Microsoft Project solution to also be selected. Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.

allowedValues.label: Dynamics 365
allowedValues.description: Ingest Dynamics 365 activity logs into Sentinel. Requires the Dynamics 365 solution to also be selected. Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.

elements.name: enableOngoingDiagnostics
elements.label: Enable Azure Policy for ongoing diagnostic settings enforcement
elements.toolTip: Creates Azure Policy assignments (deployIfNotExists) for each selected resource type. New resources are automatically configured. Also triggers a remediation task to catch any existing non-compliant resources. Requires Owner on subscription.

options.text: Azure Key Vault, NSG, Storage, SQL Database, Azure Firewall, and Application Gateway WAF do not have Sentinel API connectors — their data is collected via Azure Diagnostics. Select resource types below to automatically configure diagnostic settings on all matching resources currently in your subscription, forwarding logs to this Sentinel workspace. Resources created after deployment will need diagnostics configured manually or via Azure Policy.

elements.name: enableDiagnosticPolicies
elements.label: Configure Azure Diagnostics for existing resources
elements.toolTip: Diagnostic settings will be configured on all matching resources found in your subscription at deployment time. Subscription Owner or Contributor permission required.

allowedValues.label: Azure Key Vault
allowedValues.description: Enables AuditEvent diagnostic logs on all Key Vaults in the subscription, forwarding to Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Azure Network Security Groups
allowedValues.description: Enables NetworkSecurityGroupEvent and NetworkSecurityGroupRuleCounter logs on all NSGs in the subscription.

allowedValues.label: Azure Storage Accounts
allowedValues.description: Enables StorageRead, StorageWrite and StorageDelete logs on the blob service of all Storage Accounts in the subscription.

allowedValues.label: Azure SQL Databases
allowedValues.description: Enables SQLSecurityAuditEvents, SQLInsights, Errors, Timeouts, Blocks and Deadlocks logs on all SQL Databases in the subscription.

allowedValues.label: Azure Firewall
allowedValues.description: Enables AzureFirewallApplicationRule, AzureFirewallNetworkRule, AzureFirewallDnsProxy, and AzureFirewallThreatIntel diagnostic logs on all Azure Firewalls in the subscription.

allowedValues.label: Azure Application Gateway (WAF)
allowedValues.description: Enables ApplicationGatewayAccessLog, ApplicationGatewayPerformanceLog, and ApplicationGatewayFirewallLog diagnostic logs on all Application Gateways in the subscription.

options.text: Please select which analytics rules you would like to enable in your Microsoft Sentinel environment

elements.name: enableScheduledAlerts
elements.label: Enable Scheduled alert rules for selected Content Hub solutions and Data Connectors?
elements.toolTip: Select to enable Scheduled and NRT analytics rules for the solutions and connectors selected in the previous tabs

constraints.validationMessage: Enables Scheduled and NRT rules matching any of the selected solutions and connectors

elements.name: severityLevels
elements.label: Select the severity of the rules to enable
elements.toolTip: Select the severity levels of the analytics rules to enable

options.text:
Azure Lighthouse delegation allows a managing service provider to access and manage this subscription from their own tenant. Enabling this creates a registration definition and assignment at subscription scope. Requires Owner on the subscription.

Common role definition IDs:
• Microsoft Sentinel Contributor — f4c81013-99ee-4d62-a7ee-b3f1f648599a
• Microsoft Sentinel Reader — 8d289c81-5878-46d4-8554-54e1e3d8b5cb
• Log Analytics Contributor — 92aaf0da-9dab-42b6-94a3-d43ce8d16293
• Monitoring Contributor — 749f88d5-cbae-40b8-bcfc-e573ddc772fa
• Reader — acdd72a7-3385-48ef-bd42-f606fba81ae7

elements.name: enableLighthouse
elements.label: Enable Azure Lighthouse delegation to a managing service provider

elements.name: mspTenantId
elements.label: Managing Tenant ID
elements.toolTip: The Azure AD tenant ID of the managing service provider.

elements.name: lighthouseOfferName
elements.label: Offer Name
elements.toolTip: Display name for this Lighthouse delegation. Used as the registration definition name.

elements.name: lighthouseOfferDescription
elements.label: Offer Description
elements.placeholder: e.g. Microsoft Sentinel management and monitoring
elements.toolTip: Optional description for this Lighthouse registration.

elements.name: lighthouseAuthorizations
elements.label: Authorizations
elements.toolTip: Each row grants a principal in the managing tenant a specific role in this subscription. Add one row per principal–role pair.
